# Phase 7 Independent Contract Read — Enactment Harness

Snapshot read: `implementation.md` @ 29539058. Governing: `enactment-harness-plan.md` (v4), `evidence-contracts-s16.md`, `rules-v2.md` incl. Amendments 4–9 and the 2026-09-13 implementation clarifications (E4 crossover-only, E5 wordlist-only, E3 small evaluator). I did not run anything; this is a read-only review of the supplied snapshot.

## All-slot checklist (14 planned runnable slots)

| Slot | Entrant | Tool(s) | Class (plan → code) | Binding rule | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | A1 | `bin/prepare --adapter transform` | replay-exact → replay-exact ✓ | `lib/bindings/prepare.py` ✓ | Present, bound |
| 2 | C8 | `bin/prepare --adapter mask` | replay-exact → ✓ | same ✓ | Present, bound |
| 3 | A5 | `bin/prepare --adapter withhold` | replay-exact → ✓ | same ✓ | Present, bound |
| 4 | A3 | `bin/churn`, `bin/seasons`, `bin/units`, `bin/orders` | replay-exact → ✓ (all four) | `_toolbelt.py` shared ✓ | Present, bound; `bin/claims`/`bin/who-benefits` omitted per plan §13 (Ruling 24 item, not a defect) |
| 5 | C5 | `bin/notation` (select+validate) | replay-exact → ✓ | `lib/bindings/notation.py` ✓ | Present, bound |
| 6 | E2 | `bin/draw` (corpus), `bin/forage`, `bin/forage-gate` | replay-exact / hash-attested / hash-attested → all ✓ | `draw.check_corpus`, `forage.py`, `forage_gate.py` ✓ | Present, bound; approved model-evaluator decision reflected (`forage_verdict.py`, MINIMUM_SURVIVORS=3 per Amendment 5) |
| 7 | E1 | `bin/draw` | replay-exact → ✓ | `lib/bindings/draw.py` ✓ | Present, bound (Amendment 4 counterfactual implemented) |
| 8 | E6 | `bin/oblique` over committed deck | replay-exact → ✓ | `lib/bindings/oblique.py` ✓ | Present; deck hash + all `knowledge/*/positions.md` pinned; discard-first-10 and fail-closed full corpus per Amendment 7 ✓ |
| 9 | E4 | `bin/breed` | replay-exact → ✓ | `lib/bindings/breed.py` ✓ | Present; crossover-only per approved 2026-09-13 scope, bound span explicitly excludes mutation/scoring/promotion |
| 10 | M1 | `bin/seal-median` + `bin/overlap` | hash-attested + replay-exact → ✓ both | `seal_median.py`, `overlap.py` ✓ | Present; overlap recomputes from pinned median/candidate/config/manifest; CHOSEN-threshold gate per plan |
| 11 | E5 | `bin/lexicon-check` | replay-exact → ✓ | `lib/bindings/lexicon_check.py` ✓ | Present; frozen 1911 surface list + regeneration chain, no concept-review step — matches approved scope; hidden-concept limitation disclosed in bound span |
| 12 | E3 | `bin/route` + `bin/frame-gate` | replay-exact + hash-attested → ✓ | `route.py` (incl. frame_chain), `frame_gate.py` ✓ | Present; small independent evaluator analogous to E2 per approved decision |
| 13 | E9 | `bin/seed-string` | replay-exact → ✓ | `lib/bindings/seed_string.py` ✓ | Present; string origin from generator (Ruling 23/Amendment 9 ✓); per-row arithmetic re-computes; causal-honesty gap remains open as contracted |
| 14 | A6 | — | — | — | **Intentionally deferred** pending Ruling 25 distinctness (plan §10). No tool, no binding, no receipts. Consistent with brief; do not treat as missing. |

No tool is missing relative to the current contracts. All binding rules declare `VERIFICATION_CLASS` in code; the gate's class check (`lib/verify/gate.py::_check_class`) matches every tool's issued class. All hash-attested rules expose `verify_attestation`, so the gate actually invokes them.

## Prioritized findings

**F1 — Medium. `prepare` negative-wordlist scan is narrower than its declared bound span.**
`lib/bindings/prepare.py` `BOUND_SPAN` says "negative wordlist absent from the reasoning span," but `_negative()` scans only `("Abstract proposal",)` for mask and `("Pass 1 proposal artifact", "Abstract proposal")` for withhold. Prose under any other H2 section (e.g. a `## Reasoning` or `## Approach` section) is never scanned, so a withheld fact or masked noun leaked there passes bind. The `raw_brief_absent` check does cover all non-trace text, so this gap is specific to the negative wordlist. Actionable: either widen `_negative` to all non-trace sections or narrow the declared span wording. (Transform/N-A is deliberate and fine.)

**F2 — Low/Medium. Plan §6.4 E1 row is stale against G4 and the implemented threshold.**
The plan's binding table still requires "Two receipts, both `os-entropy`," while §4/G4, `lib/verify/dispatch.py`, and the official gate require `seed.source: argument` from the committed dispatch log (os-entropy is unattested/fails). Implementation follows G4, correctly. Separately, the counterfactual "committed similarity threshold" is hardcoded (`SIMILARITY_MAX = 0.8` in `lib/bindings/draw.py`), not a committed config value. Actionable: update the plan text and either commit the threshold or record the hardcoded value as the committed threshold.

**F3 — Low. Item-line matching in E1/E9 bindings can hit trace lines, not just mechanism output.**
`lib/bindings/draw.py::_item_line` and `lib/bindings/seed_string.py::_find_item_line` return the *first* line anywhere in the record matching `^\s*n\.\s`, and label checks are case-insensitive substring containment. A numbered line inside Execution trace (e.g. a copied tool dump) could satisfy `item_labels`. Verbatim-output checks elsewhere partially mitigate. Actionable: scope the item-line search to the mechanism-output section, or accept and record the wider span.

**F4 — Low (informational, not a violation). E4 seed is nearly decorative for the two main sections.**
`lib/breed.py::render` takes Core Principles always from parent A and Methodology always from parent B; the seed only orders the Anti-Patterns interleave. This satisfies the approved crossover-only scope ("two distinct parents, a seed, a literal child") literally, and the bound span is honest, but the commissioner should know the seed does not influence the two substantive sections. Not re-opening the approved choice; flagging for the readiness review.

**F5 — Low (environmental, fail-closed). E2/M1 bind-time network dependency.**
`lib/bindings/forage.py` → `lib.forage.verify_attestation` → `verify_remote` makes live Wikipedia calls during bind/gate; `overlap`'s entailment scoring needs the pinned model cache and runtime. Both fail closed (errors become problems/FAILs), which is safe, but the render-time gate is network- and environment-dependent — consistent with plan §9's "network at dispatch is unconfirmed" risk, not a defect.

**F6 — Low (design note). `bin/draw` and `bin/seed-string` accept any entrant code.**
Neither tool restricts `--entrant` (unlike breed/oblique/route/notation/overlap/lexicon/forage). Stray receipts under other codes are contained by the gate's single-citation and entrant-match checks (`_check_citation` fails uncited receipts), so this is an accidental-misuse surface only, consistent with §4's guardrail framing.

## Separation of concerns (per brief)

- **Implementation defects:** F1 (real, actionable), F3 (real, minor). F2 is a plan-text/commitment mismatch, not a code defect.
- **Pending Phase 8 integration:** gate wiring into `build_s16_packets.py`, enactment directives, `official-runs/README.md` receipt-ID requirement — all correctly outstanding and not treated as defects here.
- **Rulings 24/25:** standing changes (14→RUNNABLE), A6 distinctness, operator/runtime choice remain open; E4/E5/E3 commissioner choices were treated as governing and were not re-opened. No semantic-proof demands were made beyond the declared bound spans.
- **Trust domain:** no deliberate-host-forgery claims made. Entrant misbinding was inspected: per-tool entrant identity checks, gate entrant-match on citation, and cross-entrant lineage scoping (`evaluation_chain`/`frame_chain` filter by entrant and tool) all hold in the snapshot.

**Recommended next checks (host authority):** (1) fix or re-scope F1 before any official pipeline dispatch; (2) reconcile plan §6.4 E1 row and commit/record the 0.8 threshold; (3) confirm bind-time network availability for the official render gate (F5); (4) optionally scope item-line searches (F3).
